summary.key_finding: Most not-yet-sourced gaps (G-2, G-4, G-8) are already resolved by the existing Stellaris paper extraction (stellaris-design-details.md). Section 6 table in analysis.md is stale relative to the gap_report.md which reflects post-extraction coverage. G-6 (Q value / post-ignition ECRH) remains open — no public source explicitly states whether steady-state ECRH drops below 50 MW after alpha self-heating. Two ARIES-CS abstracts added as stellarator power plant cost analogues.
